offering_description.value: Operates online auctions and physical yards that sell damaged, salvage and total-loss vehicles on behalf of insurers and other sellers. Buyers are mainly dealers, rebuilders, exporters and individuals, who bid online and collect vehicles from the company's locations.

primary_products.value: used vehicles; salvage vehicles; vehicle parts

primary_services.value: online vehicle auctions; vehicle storage and yard services; vehicle title processing; vehicle transportation

customer_segment.value: B2B: insurance companies, vehicle dealers, rebuilders, exporters; B2G: government agencies selling surplus or seized vehicles

end_markets.value: automotive; insurance; vehicle remarketing; export trade

revenue_model.value: service fees: seller and buyer fees charged per vehicle sold at auction; transaction or usage fees: yard storage and late charges on vehicles held at its locations
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in vehicles from insurers and sellers and sells them at auction for a fee; software / platform: runs an online bidding platform connecting sellers with buyers worldwide; asset operator: owns and operates yards where vehicles are stored, inspected and released
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: US and Canada, with operations in the UK, Brazil, UAE and other countries

specialization.value: niche specialist: vehicle remarketing auctions for salvage and total-loss vehicles

distribution_channels.value: online: online auctions where buyers bid remotely; own locations: company-operated yards where vehicles are held and picked up

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state vehicle title, salvage and dealer licensing rules, plus environmental and transport rules
